name: Camp Norwich
description_short: YMCA day camp on 175 acres around Lake Norwich in Huntington, with campers in small same age groups. Days include swim lessons, boating, archery, fishing, crafts and a low ropes course, with a CIT program for teens entering grades 9 and 10.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers have swim instruction and free swim daily in Lake Norwich.
refund_policy_summary: All payments except the $110 non refundable down payment are refundable before May 13, 2026; after that, refunds only with a physician's note excluding the camper from more than half the session.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Camp Norwich session dates; ages 5 to 15; 9:00 am to 4:00 pm; units Explorers (entering K to 2), Adventurers (3 to 5), Trailblazers (6 to 8), CIT (entering 9 and 10, two 4 week sessions by application). Session prices are the non member camp fees from the 2026 brochure.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 brochure: two week sessions $749 ($589 household member), one week Session 5 $375 ($295 member); price_per_week is the one week Session 5 fee. Financial assistance by income grid, not applicable to the bus fee.
